official_android_docs.claim: swangle is documented as SwiftShader software drivers using an ANGLE backend.

aosp_reference.claim: The observed SWANGLE path chooses ANGLE libraries, a SwiftShader Vulkan ICD and the SwiftShader ANGLE platform.
aosp_reference.limit: Moving public development branch, not a build-source identification for the actual 37.2.13 emulator. The real new backend must be measured.

acceptance: Exactly hw.gpu.mode=swangle and exactly one actual GLES line containing separate ANGLE and SwiftShader tokens; a SWANGLE token alone is insufficient. Launch failure is failure, no automatic fallback.
